name: Tomba
summary: Find, verify and enrich professional emails, phone numbers and company data by domain, name, LinkedIn URL or article.
notes: Both the key and the secret are needed on every call.
Credits are separate pools (search, verification, email count, sources); you are charged only on HTTP 200 with a qualifying result, and an identical repeat inside the usage window is free.
Not found is usually HTTP 200 with a null email or an errors object; check errors before reading data.
Set client timeouts of at least 180 seconds; lookups run live.
Bulk jobs, scrape campaigns, leads, lead lists, API key management and flag endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account and credit usage
endpoints.summary: Plan, allowances (available and used) and the usage window.
notes: Free. Remaining balance is available minus used. The answer includes your API secret; do not log it.

endpoints.name: Search emails at a domain
endpoints.summary: Company behind a domain and one page of its known addresses with names, titles and verification.

company.description: Company name (3 to 75 characters); used if no domain.

limit.description: Addresses per page: 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 150, 200 and larger values. Default 10.

enrich_mobile.description: Add phone numbers in phone_data at extra credit cost (5 per number).

notes: Send domain or company.

Costs 1 search credit per 10 of the requested limit (rounded up), plus 5 per returned address with phone data; charged when at least one address is returned. Free plan outside a workspace fails above limit 10.
Set a client timeout of at least 180 seconds.

endpoints.name: Find a person's email
endpoints.summary: Email from a name and a company domain or name.

full_name.description: Full name, used when first and last are not both sent.

enrich_mobile.description: Add phone numbers in phone_data at extra credit cost (5 per number).

notes: Send domain or company, and first_name+last_name or full_name.
1 search credit (6 with phone data), charged when an address is returned with a status other than unknown. No address found answers 200 with data.email null.

endpoints.name: Find an email from a LinkedIn URL

enrich_mobile.description: Add phone numbers in phone_data at extra credit cost (5 per number).

full.description: Return up to two stored addresses as an array; no phone_data.

notes: 1 search credit (6 with phone data), charged when an address is returned; with full=true, 1 per address plus 5 per phone.

endpoints.name: Find an article author's email
endpoints.summary: Reads an article and finds its author's email.
notes: 1 search credit, charged when an address is returned.

endpoints.name: Verify an email address
endpoints.summary: Whether an address can receive mail.

enrich_mobile.description: Add phone numbers in phone_data at extra credit cost (5 per number).

notes: 1 verification credit, plus 5 per phone number returned with enrich_mobile; charged unless the status is disposable or unknown.

endpoints.name: Count known emails for a domain
endpoints.summary: Counts by type, department and seniority.
notes: 1 email-count credit on every call.

endpoints.name: Enrich an email address
endpoints.summary: Person details for an email in Tomba's format.

enrich_mobile.description: Add phone numbers in phone_data at extra credit cost (5 per number).

notes: 1 search credit (6 with phone data), charged when an address is returned with a status other than unknown.

endpoints.name: Find phone numbers
endpoints.summary: Phones from an email, a company domain or a LinkedIn URL.

domain.description: Company domain, for the company's number.

full.description: Return every number found as an array.

notes: Send at least one of email, domain, linkedin.
5 search credits, or 1 if the request includes domain; charged when a valid number is returned.

endpoints.name: Validate a phone number
endpoints.summary: Validity, formats, line type, carrier and region.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code for numbers without a prefix.

notes: 1 search credit on every successful response.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company from a domain
notes: 1 search credit when a company is returned. No match answers 200 with an errors object instead of data.

endpoints.name: Enrich a person from an email
notes: 1 search credit when a person is returned. No match answers 200 with an errors object instead of data.

endpoints.name: Enrich a person and their company
endpoints.summary: Person and company in one call.
notes: 2 search credits when a person is returned.

endpoints.name: Get a domain's technologies
notes: Not charged but needs a positive search balance. Unseen domains are detected live except on the Free plan.

endpoints.name: Find similar companies
endpoints.summary: Competitors and similar companies, 25 per page.

company.description: Company name (3 to 75 characters); wins if Tomba knows the company.

limit.description: Only sets the credit cost; page size is always 25. Values 10, 20, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250.

notes: 1 search credit per 10 of the requested limit (rounded up), when results are returned.

endpoints.name: Search companies by filters or text
endpoints.summary: Company database search, 50 per page; a natural-language query generates the filters.

query.description: Natural-language description, 8 to 100 characters. Filters are generated from it and any filters you send are ignored.

filters.description: Structured filters (company, founded, size, revenue and more), each with include/exclude lists. Reuse meta.filters from a query answer for later pages.

notes: A read over POST: nothing is changed.
1 search credit per request that returns a company. Fixed rate limit rather than plan limits.

endpoints.name: Check whether a domain is webmail or disposable

domain.description: Domain to check; a URL is accepted.

notes: Free and not rate-limited. The answer is a flat object, not wrapped in data.
